intro.English: Pick a Hero and a job then embark on an eternal journey of dungeon descending.
intro.Chinese: 选择一名英雄和一个职业，踏上不断深入永恒地牢的冒险旅程。
intro.Chinese (Traditional): 選擇一名英雄與一個職業，踏上不斷深入永恆地牢的冒險旅程。

intro.English: Acquire random abilities and jobs through the journey and build your own unique play style.
intro.Chinese: 在旅途中获得随机技能与职业，打造属于自己的独特玩法。
intro.Chinese (Traditional): 在旅途中獲得隨機技能與職業，打造屬於自己的獨特玩法。

features.English: Rogue lite, procedural enemies and events generation.
features.Chinese: Roguelite 玩法，敌人与事件均为程序随机生成。
features.Chinese (Traditional): Roguelite 玩法，敵人與事件皆為程序隨機生成。

features.English: Dungeon crawler, descend into the dungeon as much as you can.
features.Chinese: 地牢探索，不断深入地牢，挑战自己的极限。
features.Chinese (Traditional): 地牢探索，不斷深入地牢，挑戰自己的極限。

features.English: Strategic deck building, build your own unique deck by adding abilities into your deck via chests and defeating enemies.
features.Chinese: 策略卡组构筑，通过开启宝箱和击败敌人将技能加入卡组，打造属于自己的独特牌组。
features.Chinese (Traditional): 策略牌組構築，透過開啟寶箱與擊敗敵人將技能加入牌組，打造屬於自己的獨特牌組。

features.English: RPG Turn-based combat system, complex but easy to play. Defeat tons of different enemies, challenging but addictive.
features.Chinese: RPG 回合制战斗系统，机制丰富但易于上手。击败大量不同敌人，挑战十足又让人上瘾。
features.Chinese (Traditional): RPG 回合制戰鬥系統，機制豐富但容易上手。擊敗大量不同敵人，充滿挑戰又令人上癮。

features.English: Equip 3 jobs at once, swap, and use their abilities strategically for powerful synergy.
features.Chinese: 可同时装备 3 个职业，在战斗中切换并策略性使用各职业技能，组合出强力联动。
features.Chinese (Traditional): 可同時裝備 3 個職業，在戰鬥中切換並策略性使用各職業技能，組合出強力連動。

features.English: Combine jobs and materials to craft new unique jobs.
features.Chinese: 组合职业与材料，合成新的独特职业。
features.Chinese (Traditional): 組合職業與材料，合成新的獨特職業。

features.English: Get new heroes from Gacha, enemies defeated from the last run will appear in a special Gacha pool!
features.Chinese: 通过召唤获得新英雄；上一局被击败的敌人会出现在特殊召唤池中！
features.Chinese (Traditional): 透過召喚獲得新英雄；上一局被擊敗的敵人會出現在特殊召喚池中！

features.English: Collect special relics to enhance your build further.
features.Chinese: 收集特殊遗物，进一步强化你的构筑。
features.Chinese (Traditional): 收集特殊遺物，進一步強化你的構築。

features.English: A lot of Memes, Anime and Movies references in the game!
features.Chinese: 游戏中包含大量梗、动漫与电影彩蛋！
features.Chinese (Traditional): 遊戲中包含大量迷因、動漫與電影彩蛋！

features.English: Free with ads and in-app purchases, remove all ads with one purchase.
features.Chinese: 免费下载，含广告与应用内购买；一次购买即可移除所有广告。
features.Chinese (Traditional): 免費下載，含廣告與應用程式內購買；一次購買即可移除所有廣告。

features.English: Portrait screen only, you can play this game with one hand.
features.Chinese: 仅支持竖屏，你可以单手游玩。
features.Chinese (Traditional): 僅支援直向畫面，你可以單手游玩。
